title: A meeting on the road
body: One morning, on their way to the deserted vineyard, the two cousins meet the farmer John Byro, who is walking to town. Mourad tells Aram to let him do the talking. The farmer studies the horse eagerly and asks its name; Mourad answers, in Armenian, 'My Heart'. John Byro says he could swear it is the horse stolen from him weeks ago and asks to look into its mouth. After checking it tooth for tooth, he says he would swear it is his horse if he did not know the boys' parents, whose honesty is well known to him. A suspicious man, he adds, would believe his eyes instead of his heart. He then wishes them good day and goes on his way.
